scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install && pnpm certs:setup && pnpm build && pnpm cmux:allow-automation && docker compose build && echo 'Bootstrap complete. Apply allowAll via cmux Settings > Automation (socket mode) OR restart cmux, then run: pnpm start'
scripts.start: test -f certs/server.pem || { echo 'certs/server.pem not found — run: pnpm certs:setup'; exit 1; }; pnpm server:up && docker compose up -d && TOKEN="${CMUX_REMOTE_TOKEN:-$(sed -n 's/^CMUX_REMOTE_TOKEN=//p' apps/server/.env 2>/dev/null | head -1)}" && TOKEN="${TOKEN:-$(cat apps/server/.run/token 2>/dev/null)}" && echo "Up. PWA (first connect, token included): https://$(scutil --get LocalHostName).local:48710/?token=${TOKEN:-<see pnpm server:logs>} | http://...:48700 redirects to https | server logs: pnpm server:logs | stop: pnpm stop"
